requirement.description: The hashlib.keccak_256 compatibility issue where the code attempts to use keccak_256 which doesn't exist in older Python versions or certain environments. Multiple test failures occur because of this in address utilities tests.
requirement.contract: Fix the keccak function to properly handle different Python environments by ensuring fallback mechanisms work correctly when hashlib.keccak_256 is not available. The implementation should try multiple approaches: first pysha3, then pycryptodome, then hashlib.sha3_256, then hashlib.new('sha3_256'), and finally fall back to pysha3 if none of the above work.

requirement.description: The rlp_encode_address_nonce_tuple function incorrectly processes address and nonce combinations, causing multiple test failures in RLP encoding tests. The function has incorrect logic for calculating lengths and building the result.
requirement.contract: Correct the rlp_encode_address_nonce_tuple function to properly build RLP-encoded address-nonce tuples. The function should correctly encode the address with 0x94 prefix and nonce with proper RLP encoding, then combine them with correct length calculation and prefix.

requirement.description: The rlp_decode function has incorrect implementation that doesn't properly decode RLP data, causing failures in RLP decoding tests.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_decode function to correctly decode RLP-encoded data by implementing proper recursive decoding logic that handles all RLP data types (single bytes, strings, lists) with correct prefix handling and byte length calculations.

requirement.description: The convert function in formats.py has issues with converting between different binary formats, causing failures in format utility tests.
requirement.contract: Fix the convert function to properly handle all input types (str, int, bytes) and correctly convert them to the specified output format (binary, raw_hex, prefix_hex, integer) without corrupting data.

requirement.description: The rlp_encode function has incomplete handling of list encoding that leads to incorrect RLP encodings for complex nested structures.
requirement.contract: Improve the rlp_encode function to correctly handle nested lists and ensure proper length calculations for both short and long lists, with correct prefix handling for different data sizes.
